## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-2: config key planning.max_remediation_cycles documented in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md with default 3 and enforced minimum of 2; values < 2 are rejected at load time (not silently clamped)

## Description

Add a new `get_max_remediation_cycles()` function to `plugins/dso/hooks/lib/planning-config.sh` that reads `planning.max_remediation_cycles` via the existing `read-config.sh` mechanism. The function MUST default to 3 when the key is absent and MUST reject values < 2 at load time by exiting non-zero AND writing a clear error to stderr — never silently clamp. Document the key in `plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md` (default 3, enforced minimum 2, rejection behavior).

## TDD Test Spec

Given a dso-config.conf with `planning.max_remediation_cycles=1`; When `get_max_remediation_cycles` is sourced and invoked; Then the function exits non-zero and stderr contains a message naming the rejected value and the minimum (2). Given the key absent; When invoked; Then it prints `3` and exits 0. Given the key set to `5`; When invoked; Then it prints `5` and exits 0.

## File Impact

| Source | Action | Tests |
|--------|--------|-------|
| plugins/dso/hooks/lib/planning-config.sh | Edit | tests/unit/shared/test-planning-config-max-remediation-cycles.sh (Create) |
| plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md | Edit | (instruction file — no test) |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] get_max_remediation_cycles rejects value 1 with non-zero exit and stderr error (no silent clamp)
  Verify: bash tests/unit/shared/test-planning-config-max-remediation-cycles.sh
- [ ] get_max_remediation_cycles returns 3 when key is absent
  Verify: bash -c 'source plugins/dso/hooks/lib/planning-config.sh && [ "$(get_max_remediation_cycles)" = "3" ]'
- [ ] CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md documents planning.max_remediation_cycles with default 3, minimum 2, and load-time rejection behavior
  Verify: grep -q 'planning.max_remediation_cycles' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md && grep -q -E 'minimum.*2|>=.*2' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md && grep -q -E 'reject|not.*clamp' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] `.test-index` updated with RED marker for the new test file
  Verify: grep -q 'test-planning-config-max-remediation-cycles' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
